_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-for-60 base rate on ±2+ point moves makes HOLD the only statistically honest call — the coil has not broken and neither brain provides a confirmed trigger that the breaker is live.
next_move.brains_agree: No — Analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction citing broken divergence; Narrative implies a pending rally but provides no timing trigger, effectively a directional lean the Analyst rejects.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 AND BTC 30-day momentum cools to 40-45, re-converging with the August Disbelief analog to unlock the Hope leg
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows stay at 0 AND VIX spikes above 70 with funding dropping below 35, which pushes into Panic and breaks the bottom analog entirely
